slides.title: Detained after burying their dead
slides.body: Shirka Woreda, Oromia. Addis Standard, Oct 28, 2026

slides.title: residents reportedly detained after the funerals
slides.body: Residents told Addis Standard that people who buried victims or helped the wounded were taken into custody.

slides.title: Mourners and helpers held
slides.body: Residents said those detained included relatives of victims, mourning women and young people who carried gunshot victims for treatment.

slides.title: killed in the Oct 24-25 attacks, residents said
slides.body: In Chole and Birbo kebeles, with 31+ injured. The regional communication bureau blamed a group it calls "Tsimdo".

slides.title: Grounds for arrests unclear
slides.body: The regional bureau could not be reached for comment. The residents' accounts have not been independently verified.

slides.title: Protect civilians. Investigate independently.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.

source: Source: Addis Standard via allAfrica, Oct 28, 2026 (residents)
